title: Ether of Orbifolds
summary: The orbifold lattice has been proposed as a route to practical quantum simulation of Yang--Mills theory, with claims of exponential speedup over all known approaches. Through analytical derivations, Monte Carlo simulation, and explicit circuit construction, we identify compounding costs entirely absent in Kogut--Susskind formulations: a mass-dependent Trotter overhead that scales as $m^4$, non-singlet contamination that grows as $m^2$ and worsens with penalty terms, and a mandatory mass extrapolation.
